· High position relative to SMA100/200($717.40/$667.97): Maintaining mid-to-long-term trend strength.

· MACD histogram trajectory (2.7978 → 2.1350): Slowing improvement, signaling weakening upward momentum.

[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($704.66): Support based on 20-day low.
· Swing Resistance ($775.41): Resistance at Pivot R1 level.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low continuation): Maintaining uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current Zone Diagnosis (Uptrend): Considering potential short-term correction due to entering overheated zone and slowing momentum, maintaining wait-and-see condition.
